assessment: This study presents important insights into the regulation of left-right organ formation. By combining genetic perturbation of all three Meteorin genes in zebrafish and timelapse imaging, the authors identify an essential role for this protein family in the establishment of left-right patterning. They provide convincing evidence that Meteorins are required for the morphogenesis of dorsal forerunner cells, the precursors of the left-right organizer (also named Kupffer's vesicle) in zebrafish. In line with this, Meteorins were shown to genetically interact with integrins ItgaV and Itgb1b to regulate dorsal forerunner cell clustering.
